I opened it, pasted a link, and hit **Get details**. That feels right. A big box front and center to drop a link into, and then it pulls up the page's picture, its icon, the site name, and fills in the title and description — with the title and description sitting there as editable boxes I can fix before saving. That's exactly the "paste and it does the busywork for me" start I was hoping for, and I like that it lets me review before committing.

This part looks good for the save flow. The natural next thing I'll want to see is what happens after I save — how these show up in a list and how I get back to them — but for what you asked, this beginning matches what I had in mind.
